experiments.name: H5 — HK peg-liquidity regime conditioner (phase-0)
experiments.what: HK/CA masterplan §3 H5 W2 phase-0. Conditioner-grade ONLY (sizes HK exposure, never ranks). Regime split on own-history 252bd percentiles: E = pct(agg_balance) - pct(hibor_1m - usd_leg); EASY E>=+33 / TIGHT E<=-33 / NEUTRAL. Two trials: (a) PRIMARY SOFR 2018-04-> (usd_leg=ofr FNYR-SOFR-A); (b) SECONDARY spliced fred:DFF<2018->SOFR, labeled discontinuity, ACCRUE-capped. Forward 1m/3m HSI, next-bar fills, HAC + episode-level effective-N + DSR n_trials=30 + split-half. VERDICT: ACCRUE. PRIMARY: EASY>TIGHT both horizons (3m diff +3.44%, HAC t=1.10 < 1.5 conditioner bar); drawdown separation strong (3m p5 -10.5% E vs -16.4% T; strat maxdd -21% E vs -49% T = 2.3x); split-half sign-stable (+4.5%/+3.4%); episodes 5 EASY/14 TIGHT (~8 econ-distinct) -> too few for t>=1.5. DSR 0.30 (far below 0.90, as pre-registered — conditioner not scored seam). Robustness: sign-stable 5/6; signal lives in agg_balance (R3-bal t=2.31) not HIBOR-USD spread (R3-spread FLIPS). Exploratory (non-gated): southbound net ~43% stronger in EASY (3324 vs 2324 mean) -> H1 should condition on H5. NO wiring.
experiments.maturation: In-tree backtest, no forward ledger. Conditioner-grade: bar = directional consistency + drawdown separation + split-half sign stability, NOT DSR>=0.90 (few regimes 2018->, per masterplan §6.1). Binding effective-N = independent debounced episodes (5 EASY / ~8 econ-distinct TIGHT), NOT daily rows (bootstrap t_eff=t_raw because signal is a persistent regime block not a daily event).

SECONDARY spliced leg is ACCRUE-capped by construction (spliced-rate conditioner not decision-grade). Do NOT promote the R1 O/N-HIBOR variant (t=3.0) — pre-registered as robustness, not primary; promoting = trial-shopping.

experiments.name: H-INCL — Stock-Connect southbound (港股通) inclusion events (phase-0 + deeper-panel re-run)
experiments.what: HK/CA masterplan §3 H-INCL W3 phase-0 (red-team's strongest new HK mechanism + supplies the PIT southbound roster H1 needs). STEP-1 roster feasibility = PASS: built data/hk_connect_roster/roster.parquet (796 rows, 2015-09->2026-07; 466 add / 330 remove events, 444 distinct add tickers) by scraping the SSE 港股通标的调整 announcement archive (dated 调入/调出 tables). Rejected routes documented: HKEX View-All = northbound only; akshare ggt_components = current snapshot; HKEX CCASS mutualmarket.aspx = strict ~365d rolling window (cannot reach 2016). STEP-2 event study on the 157-name closes_deep panel: 2 gated trials {announcement-drift, effective-day-demand}, index-relative CAR vs _HSI, next-bar fills, episode-N=distinct add-date, HAC + BH-FDR + DSR n_trials=30 + split-half + survivorship LB. VERDICT: NO-GO both. Only 39/466 add events land in-panel -> K=25 episodes. T-ANN +20d mean CAR +1.57% HAC t=0.46 DSR=0.074 split-half FLIPS; T-EFF +20d -1.04% t=-0.29 DSR=0.007 FLIPS; BH-FDR rejects neither (q=0.61). Event-time curve: name rallies +5.3% vs HSI in t-10->0 (pre-fill), then flat/-0.3% to +20d -> the inclusion demand is impounded BEFORE the dashboard's next-open fill (implementation-lag kill). Marginal T-ANN +5d (t=1.65, DSR 0.28) = fast-decay drift hint -> ACCRUE seed. NO wiring. || RE-RUN (2026-07-03, research/HINCL2_PREREG.md, PR hkca-w3-hincl2): the registered DATA-based ACCRUE path executed on the 545-name UNION panel (closes_deep 157 ∪ hk_stocks 157 ∪ hk_stocks_ext 388). COVERAGE 38->275/444 add tickers (7.2x); episode-K 25->74; HSI refreshed to 2026-07-03; DSR n_trials 30->32. VERDICT: NO-GO both, ROBUSTLY. T-ANN +20d mean CAR -8.81% (screened -2.6%) HAC t=-1.66 DSR=0 split-half stably NEG; T-EFF +20d -8.90% (screened -4.6%) t=-1.77 DSR=0; BH-FDR rejects neither (q=0.96). Negative sign FAILS ACCRUE (needs positive); |t|<2 not KILL. Run-1's +5.3% pre-fill rally REVISED AWAY (mega-cap-only artifact; broad-panel t-10->0 run-up is flat/slightly-neg). Run-1 T-ANN +5d accrue seed (t=+1.65) COLLAPSES to -0.2% (t=-0.19). Left-tail carried corporate-action artifacts (single-day |logret|>1.0); screening them cuts magnitude but not sign/verdict; run-1 closes_deep names reproduce ~flat as positive control. EXPLORATORY removal (调出) side, bigger n (76 ev, K=27): removal ANNOUNCE precedes -6.5% vs HSI +20d, HAC t=-3.93 (screened) — the first |t|>2 this battery produced, but non-gated + survivorship-selected. NO wiring.
